## Common questions about University of Wyoming costs
What is the real cost of University of Wyoming?  
Published tuition and fees at University of Wyoming are $6,938 for 2023-24. The average net price, the full cost of attendance minus grant and scholarship aid, was $13,299 (2022-23 IPEDS Student Financial Aid data, retrieved 2026-08-13). Your price depends mostly on household income.
How much aid do students at University of Wyoming get?  
89 percent of full-time first-time undergraduates at University of Wyoming received grant or scholarship aid in 2022-23 (IPEDS, retrieved 2026-08-13). The income bracket table on this page shows the average net price after that aid.
Do students at University of Wyoming get Pell Grants?  
22 percent of full-time first-time undergraduates at University of Wyoming received a federal Pell Grant in 2022-23, averaging $5,147 (IPEDS Student Financial Aid data, retrieved 2026-08-13). Pell eligibility is determined by your FAFSA, not by the school.
Is University of Wyoming worth the cost?  
Federal data reports outcomes without judging value. Median federal loan debt at graduation is $18,000. Median earnings 10 years after entry are $56,880 (College Scorecard). Compare those figures with the net price for your income bracket to judge fit for your situation.
What is the acceptance rate at University of Wyoming?  
In the 2023-24 admissions cycle, University of Wyoming received 5,644 applications and admitted 5,498, an acceptance rate of about 97 percent (IPEDS Admissions survey, retrieved 2026-08-13). Rates describe a past cycle and can change.

## Common questions about University of Wyoming costs
What does University of Wyoming require to apply?  
For the 2023-24 cycle, University of Wyoming reported requiring: college-prep program, english proficiency test, high school gpa, and high school record (IPEDS Admissions survey, retrieved 2026-08-13). Other factors may be considered without being required; the full checklist is on this page, and requirements can change between cycles.
How much is the application fee at University of Wyoming?  
The undergraduate application fee at University of Wyoming is $40 as reported for 2023-24 (IPEDS, retrieved 2026-08-13). Fee waivers may be available; ask the admissions office.

# Four-Year Colleges and Universities in Wyoming
## About This List
Are you thinking about attending college in the Equality State? You can check out all the four-year colleges and universities in Wyoming right here.
Wyoming offers students a unique educational experience characterized by strong academic programs, personalized attention, and breathtaking natural surroundings. The state’s colleges and universities emphasize a close-knit, community-oriented approach, where students often benefit from smaller class sizes and more personalized interactions with faculty. College life in Wyoming is intertwined with the state’s outdoor culture, providing students with unparalleled access to natural beauty like Yellowstone and Grand Teton National Parks, where they can engage in activities like hiking, skiing, rock climbing, and wildlife observation. The state’s wide-open spaces and majestic mountain ranges offer a peaceful and inspiring backdrop for study and exploration. With a lower cost of living and a focus on student-centered education, attending college in Wyoming promises a blend of academic rigor and outdoor adventure that is both enriching and memorable.
To explore even further, just click on any school name to access its CollegeXpress profile and learn more about admission policies, campus life, and more. You can also click the green **“Yes, connect me!”** buttons next to our featured colleges and universities to demonstrate your interest and send your info directly to schools, making your college search process even easier.

## Common questions about Central Wyoming College costs
What is the real cost of Central Wyoming College?  
Published tuition and fees at Central Wyoming College are $4,680 for 2023-24. The average net price, the full cost of attendance minus grant and scholarship aid, was $10,108 (2022-23 IPEDS Student Financial Aid data, retrieved 2026-08-13). Your price depends mostly on household income.

Central Wyoming College has open admissions: applicants who meet the basic requirements are admitted, and there is no competitive selection process (IPEDS 2023-24, retrieved 2026-08-13).

No. Central Wyoming College reported no undergraduate application fee to the U.S. Department of Education for 2023-24 (retrieved 2026-08-13).
